title: Keep a decisions log file across turns (3 turns)

turns.prompt: Keep a decisions log for me in {D}/decisions.md (create it). First entry: we chose Postgres 16 for the new service; owner Lena.
turns.verify: f={D}/decisions.md; test -f $f && grep -qi postgres $f && grep -qi lena $f && echo PASS || echo FAIL: first entry missing

turns.prompt: Add another decision: the nightly ETL moves to 04:00 UTC; owner Mateo.
turns.verify: f={D}/decisions.md; grep -qi 'etl' $f && grep -q '04:00' $f && grep -qi mateo $f && grep -qi postgres $f && echo PASS || echo FAIL: second entry missing or first lost

turns.prompt: Show me the decisions log as it stands.
